anomalies.observed: The STM32H753 FCC1 VDD pins (11, 27, 50, 75, 100), VDDA (21), VREF+ (20) and the STM32F405 NAVC1 VDD pins (19, 32, 48, 64) are all on unconnected nets. The decoupling capacitors on the +3V3 net are not connected to these MCU power pins.
anomalies.expected: All VDD, VDDA, VREF+ and VBAT pins must be connected to the appropriate 3.3V rail and GND for the MCUs to operate. The specification states the 3V3 rail feeds both MCUs and all I2C sensors.
anomalies.impact: The FCC and NAVC MCUs are not powered. The board will not boot or function at all.

anomalies.observed: The FCC1 HSE crystal HSE1 is wired to FCC1 pins 5 (PE6) and 37 (PE7), which are GPIO pins, not the dedicated HSE oscillator pins PH0/PH1 (pins 12/13). Additionally, FCC1 VCAP pins 48 and 73 are connected to the UART3 connector pins 3 and 4 on nets UART3_TX_FCC and UART3_RX_FCC.
anomalies.expected: HSE1 must connect to FCC1 PH0 (pin 12) and PH1 (pin 13). VCAP pins 48 and 73 must each have a 2.2uF capacitor to GND and must not connect to any external connector. UART3 must connect to actual UART3 pins (e.g., PB10/PB11 or PD8/PD9).
anomalies.impact: The FCC has no external clock, so it cannot run from the intended 25MHz HSE. The VCAP pins are internal core regulator outputs; connecting them to an external connector can damage the MCU and prevents proper core voltage decoupling.

anomalies.observed: The reset (NRST) and boot (BOOT0/BOOT1) pins of both MCUs are not connected to their respective reset switches, boot-select switches, or SWD connectors. NAVC1 VCAP pins 31 and 47 are also unconnected.
anomalies.expected: NRST pins must connect to the reset switch, capacitor, and SWD reset line. BOOT0/BOOT1 must connect to the boot-select switches. VCAP pins must have 2.2uF capacitors to GND.
anomalies.impact: Reset and boot mode selection do not reach the MCUs. The board cannot be reset via button or debugger, and boot mode cannot be changed. NAVC core regulator is not decoupled, risking unstable operation or damage.
